newsitem.title: CANADA: Newbridge hit by Cascade meltdown.
newsitem.headline: Newbridge hit by Cascade meltdown.

text.p: Shares in Newbridge Networks Corp sank on Friday, hurt by a meltdown in the stock of networking rival Cascade Communications Corp, which panicked the street with its fourth-quarter report.
Newbridge was down 1.70 at 44.10 on the Toronto Stock Exchange and 1-1/4 to 32-5/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
"We went out this morning and reiterated our buy on Newbridge and Ascend (Communications Inc )," said Robert MacLellan, analyst at Dillon Read.
"We had a note out this morning saying everybody should ignore any spillover on to Newbridge and Ascend and buy them."
Cascade fell 21-1/4 to 42-7/8 in brisk trading on Nasdaq.

The sharp decline was sparked when Cascade reported fourth-quarter results after Thursday's close that raised concerns about margins and growth in the company's mainstay frame relay business, one analyst said.
The quarter was seen as "back-end loaded," in that a vast majority of the revenue was recorded in the last six weeks of the period. A raft of downgrades and estimate cuts followed.
"I think they still have further to go. They're still trading at about 39 times next year's earnings," said one analyst who asked not to be identified.
"The view on the street is (Cascade) is now becoming a typical US$400 million datacomm company," the analyst added.

That meant, said the analyst, that Cascade might occasionally post a disappointing quarter, experience some bumpy transitions from one product to the next and need to expand its geographical reach and product portfolio.
